desc: Plan, draft, audit, and publish content for Instagram. Use when the user wants to write a caption with a first-125-char hook, plan a slide-by-slide carousel, reverse-engineer the hook from a viral Reel or carousel, size hashtags the 2026 way, remove AI tells from a caption, or plan a week of Reels and carousels.
